title: Bimodal versus unimodal high-definition Transcranial random noise stimulation of auditory cortex for tinnitus: A double-blind, sham-controlled crossover trial
title_zh: 耳鸣听觉皮层双模式与单模式高清晰度经颅随机噪声刺激：一项双盲、假刺激对照的交叉试验
abstract: BACKGROUND: Transcranial random noise stimulation (tRNS) targeting auditory cortex has shown preliminary promise for chronic tinnitus, but evidence is dominated by small studies and powered trials are scarce. A single-session pilot suggested that pairing HD-tRNS with acoustic input may augment its effects, whether this holds over repeated sessions is unknown. OBJECTIVE: We investigated whether repeated sessions of HD-tRNS over bilateral auditory cortex, delivered alone or combined with acoustic stimulation, modulate tinnitus loudness, auditory deviant processing, and resting-state connectivity. METHODS: Thirty-five participants with chronic tinnitus completed a double-blind, sham-controlled crossover trial. Participants were assigned to bimodal (HD-tRNS plus acoustic stimulation) or unimodal (HD-tRNS alone) arms, each with active and sham blocks of 10 sessions over bilateral Heschl's gyrus. Outcomes included minimum masking level (MML), visual analogue scales for loudness and distress, mismatch negativity to intensity deviants, and resting-state connectivity. RESULTS: No consistent treatment effect emerged. Bayesian evidence favoured the null for the primary loudness outcome (BF01=4.79), and neither primary mismatch negativity outcome survived correction. For MML, the main treatment effect was null, but an unexpected group × treatment interaction emerged at post (p=0.039), mirrored in connectivity. CONCLUSION: Repeated HD-tRNS produced no group-level benefit, alone or combined with acoustic stimulation, adding a well-controlled null to a mixed literature.
abstract_zh: 背景：针对听觉皮层的经颅随机噪声刺激（tRNS）在慢性耳鸣中显示出初步前景，但证据主要来自小规模研究，有效性试验稀缺。单次会话的试点研究表明，将高清晰度tRNS（HD-tRNS）与声学输入结合可能增强其效果，但这一效果在重复会话中是否成立尚不清楚。目标：我们调查了在双侧听觉皮层上进行重复HD-tRNS（单独进行或结合声学刺激）是否调节耳鸣响度、听觉偏差处理和静息状态连接。方法：35名慢性耳鸣参与者完成了一项双盲、假刺激对照的交叉试验。参与者被分配至双模式（HD-tRNS加声学刺激）或单模式（HD-tRNS单独进行）组，每组在双侧赫希尔回上接受10次会话的活性和假刺激区块。结果包括最小掩蔽水平（MML）、用于响度和痛苦的视觉模拟量表、强度偏差的失配负电位以及静息状态连接。结果：未出现一致的治疗效果。贝叶斯证据支持原始响度结果的零假设（BF01=4.79），且原始失配负电位结果均未通过矫正。对于MML，主要治疗效果为零，但在事后出现了意外的组×治疗交互作用（p=0.039），连接结果也呈现类似情况。结论：重复HD-tRNS在群组层面未产生益处，无论单独使用还是结合声学刺激，为混杂的文献增加了一项受控良好的零结果。
